payload.prompt: Rain falls harder; the sea heaves in long slow swells; the cyan light inside the carved grooves pulses gently. The camera keeps drifting forward over the water.
The enormous fish-shaped mass glides slowly past from left to right, its outline seams brightening as it passes; motes of light swirl in its wake. The camera tilts down to follow it.
The scales' seams pulse once, slowly, from front to back; the great eye rolls a few degrees toward the camera; water streams over the plates. The camera pushes in slightly.

The rising bulk breaks fully free of the water and its body opens outward into two immense wings that unfold across the whole sky; the wall of water collapses back into the sea beneath it. The camera cranes upward to hold the wingspan.
The immense wings beat once, slowly and heavily; the shadow sweeps across the mountain ridge; torn cloud streams off the trailing edges. The camera pans right to follow.
The wall of thrown water races outward along the horizon and the torn spray streams away southward; the sea beneath boils white. The camera tracks sideways with the moving wall of water.
The bird continues its slow upward spiral; the cloud floor rolls and shears beneath it; the distant woman's robe and hair lift in the wind. The camera rises slowly.

The wind gusts harder; his robe and hair whip sideways; the distant bird slides further toward the horizon; he turns his head a few degrees to keep it in view. The camera pushes in slowly past his shoulder.
He finishes rolling the bundle and ties the cord; the lamp flame wavers and the shadows shift across the table; rain runs off the eaves outside the doorway. The camera drifts slowly to the left.
The cicada's wings buzz and rattle; the dove bobs its head twice and shuffles along the branch; leaves shake around them. The camera drifts slowly right.
The dove clips the branch, tumbles, and drops to the packed earth, landing badly and folding its wings; leaves fall after it. The camera tilts down to follow it to the ground.
The traveller walks steadily away, the huge load swaying with each step; dust drifts across the track; the cloud ceiling moves. The camera slowly cranes up and back.
He completes his turn and walks back toward the village; the millet moves in the wind; smoke rises from a roof behind. The camera pans left with him.
The light warms and swings across as the sun climbs; the beads of water shrink away and the cap edge curls and darkens. The camera creeps slowly closer.
A gust moves the twig; the cicada's grip slackens and its wings sag open; the green leaves behind stir. The camera drifts slightly around it.
One cyan ring seam lights up and travels outward through the bark to the next ring, then fades; mist moves between the roots. The camera cranes slowly upward along the trunk.
Cloud drags across the crown and tears open; a slow pulse of cyan light climbs the trunk from the roots into the cloud. The camera pushes in very slowly.
The sparrow skims across the frame and drops out of sight into the scrub; the weeds swing where it passed; his robe stirs and he turns his head to follow it. The camera pans right with the bird.
Both crowds press closer and gesture harder, robes and sleeves swinging; the man in the centre stands perfectly still throughout. The camera arcs slowly around him.
The vapour sheets under his feet slide and re-form and he glides forward across the frame; his sleeves and hem snap in the wind. The camera tracks alongside him.
Nothing moves but a single thin line of dust that lifts, travels a short way, and settles again; his robe stays completely still. The camera pulls back slowly.
The older man extends the bronze tally further and his sleeves fall back; cloud spills over the balustrade behind them; the seams in the stone brighten. The camera pushes in slowly between them.
He completes the turn and takes the first step down; the older man's arms slowly lower; wind drags cloud across the terrace behind them. The camera holds and lets him walk out of frame left.
The small bird settles deeper into the nest and turns once; the branch dips slightly and the leaves behind it drift. The camera pulls back steadily to reveal more forest.
The mole-rat drinks, lifts its head, and turns back up the bank away from the water; the river keeps running hard behind it. The camera tilts up from the animal to the far bank.
Her very long hair and the trailing sleeves lift and drift in the thin wind; snow streams off the ridge edge in front of her; the cloud sea below rolls slowly. The camera pushes in slowly.
The dragon's body undulates and drives forward through the cloud; her robe and hair stream back; the cloud sea tears past beneath them. The camera tracks alongside at speed.
The split widens and the water runs out faster; his arms sag under the weight and he shifts his grip; the wet patch spreads across the earth. The camera pushes in slightly.
The stout man gestures at the halves and lets his hands drop; a little rainwater slides across the inside of one bowl; the other man crouches down toward it. The camera arcs slowly to the left.

He stays flat on his back the whole time, body and legs level with the surface. The current turns him slowly and carries him downstream; ripples spread out from under him; the far cloud bank drifts. The camera rises and pulls back.
He jabs his pointing hand twice at the trunk and lets it fall; the crooked branches move in the wind; weeds sway across the rubble. The camera drifts slowly right along the trunk.

He walks steadily past and out of frame right with his gaze fixed down the road; the axe sways on his shoulder; the crooked branches move behind him. The camera tracks with him and then holds on the tree.
Wind combs long waves across the grass toward the tree and the crooked branches answer; the cloud shadow slides over the plain. The camera cranes slowly up and back.
He strolls a few paces along the trunk and turns unhurriedly back the other way; grass brushes his hem; the low sun rakes across him. The camera arcs slowly around the trunk with him.
His chest rises and falls slowly; leaves drift down through the frame; her sleeves and hair move in the evening air. The camera drifts in very slowly and low.
The immense bird crosses slowly toward frame right; the grass moves in long waves below; the light drops another stop. The camera holds still and lets the bird traverse.
